card.name: 11im Straight Deals
card.description: Rules. 1) Ask for one product by SKU; add 'must last N hours' for food or 'warranty N hours' or 'grade A' if your accept policy needs it. 2) The first reply states the unit's grade, hours of shelf life left, certificate and warranty, and says up front when we cannot meet what you asked, with another SKU of the same category if one can. 3) The ask is the last number of every reply and the 'ask' field of the JSON data part; send it to close at once. 4) An offer within 3% of the ask closes at once; each counter moves 40% of the way to your offer; 'final': true means it goes no lower. 5) Every unit ships with the market certificate; the grade claim is the grade at checkout. Receipts and ACP checkouts are Ed25519-signed. Prices are set by code, answers take under a second, no review requests.
